description_en: Queries the Microservices Engine (MSE) microservice governance application information associated with an application
description_zh: 查询应用关联的MSE微服务治理应用信息
kebab_example: aliyun sae describe-application-mse-service --app-id f7730764-d88f-4b9a-8d8e-cd8efbfe0000 --enable-ahas true --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApplicationMseService

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the throttling and degradation feature is enabled. Set this parameter to true when you call API operations related to throttling and degradation. Otherwise, set this parameter to false. Valid values:
true: Checks the permissions for throttling and degradation.
false: Does not check the permissions for throttling and degradation
parameters.help_zh:
是否为限流降级功能。访问限流降级相关接口时填true，否则填false。
true 检查限流降级权限
false 不需要检查限流降级权限
parameters.name: enable_ahas

Code.description_en: The API status code or POP error code. Valid values: 2xx: success. 3xx: redirection. 4xx: request error. 5xx: server error
Code.description_zh: 接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：2xx：成功。3xx：重定向。4xx：请求错误。5xx：服务器错误

Data.description_en: The MSE microservice governance application information
Data.description_zh: MSE 微服务治理的应用信息

MseAppId.description_en: The MSE microservice governance application ID
MseAppId.description_zh: MSE 微服务治理的应用ID

MseAppName.description_en: The MSE microservice governance application name
MseAppName.description_zh: MSE 微服务治理的应用名

MseAppNameSpace.description_zh: MSE 微服务治理的命名空间

Status.description_en:
The MSE microservice governance application status. Valid values:
EXPIRED: The feature has expired or is not activated.
REBOOTING: The application is restarting.
WAITING: Waiting for the application to restart.
FAIL: The activation failed.
NULL/SUCCESS: The activation succeeded
Status.description_zh:
MSE 微服务治应用状态
EXPIRED 已过期或者未开通相关功能
REBOOTING 应用重启中
WAITING 等待应用重启
FAIL 开通失败
NULL/SUCCESS 开通成功

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code. Details:

If the request is successful, the ErrorCode parameter is not returned.
If the request fails, the ErrorCode parameter is returned. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The additional information. Details:

If the request is normal, success is returned.
If the request is abnormal, a specific error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the application instance group was retrieved successfully. Valid values:

true: The application instance group was retrieved successfully.
false: The application instance group failed to be retrieved
Success.description_zh:
获取应用实例分组是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：表示获取成功。
false：表示获取失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID, which is used to precisely query trace information
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
